body:
I believe your bean was detected as unused by Arc and was subsequently removed. See [here](https://quarkus.io/guides/cdi-reference#remove_unused_beans).

As a workaround, annotate your type with `@Unremovable`.

We should add something in the extension to tell Quarkus that anything annotated with `@ElasticsearchClientConfiguration` should not be considered as unused.

issue.title: Make classes marked with ElasticsearchClientConfig application scoped and unremovable

body:
Hi, I was also able to reproduce the problem with a bean which is annotated with  `@Unremovable` , `@Dependent` and `@ElasticsearchClientConfig`. 

When I select the bean through Arc using its implementation class (or `RestClientBuilder.HttpClientConfigCallback` with `@Any` qualifier) and inspect the returned beans qualifiers, `@ElasticsearchClientConfig` is not listed among them. It seams to have only  `@Default` and `@Any`. I suspect `@ElasticsearchClientConfig` is not registering as a qualifier somehow. Could it be because the qualifier definition has `@Target({ FIELD, TYPE, PARAMETER })` instead of ` @Target({METHOD, FIELD, PARAMETER, TYPE})`?
We need to make `ElasticsearchClientConfig` a bean.

issue.title: Register ElasticsearchClientConfig qualifier as a bean
